thread:
Ria: hey team, quick question — the dashboard snippet in the Console docs for 'cost-per-route' seems to break when trace samples are missing. Repro: when span_id is null the viz throws a 500. anyone seen this?
Sam: saw something similar in runtime metrics, probably the query assumes non-null span_id. can you paste the snippet?
Ria: pasted below:
```
{
  \"panels\": [
    { \"id\": 1, \"type\": \"timeseries\", \"targets\": [{\"expr\": \"sum(cost_total) by (route, span_id)\"}] }
  ]
}
```
Maria: yep, grouping by span_id is fragile. For the Console migration docs we should recommend `coalesce(span_id, \"none\")` so panels don't error and grouping is explicit. also add note about traces sampled=false.
Ria: ok i'll update PR with coalesce. also found a broken link to the tracing hook example — points to /tracing-hook.md but the file moved.
Jason: updated link should be /observability/tracing-hooks#example-setup. want me to push a quick commit?
Ria: please, thanks. also need a short SDK snippet showing how to tag requests with route metadata for cost breakdowns. small code sample is enough.
Sam: i can add node/python snippets, here's node quick:
```js
// attach route metadata
const res = await client.generate(\"\", {metadata:{route: \"signup-flow\"}});
```
Ria: perfect. i'll include both in the PR and ping reviewers.
docbot: New PR opened: #2142 — docs(console): dashboard snippet coalesce + tracing link + sdk samples (:github:).
Maria: taking a look now. small request — add migration note: \"old dashboards that grouped by span_id should be updated to coalesce(span_id, 'none') to avoid panel errors\".
Sam: also add a regression test snippet (curl) to verify panel query doesn't 500: `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (route, coalesce(span_id, \"none\"))"}' | jq`
Ria: will do. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Jason: FYI i'll schedule the merge after CI passes; expect ~20m.
Ria: sounds good — tagging @maria for final signoff.
Maria: approved. :white_check_mark:
Ria: merged. note: changed doc permalinks — need redirects? cc eng-frontend.
Sam: filed issue ENG-457 for redirect.
Ria: closing thread. thanks!
